newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian stocks dip on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Colombian stocks dip on profit-taking.

text.p: Colombian stocks dipped on proft-taking in banking and brewing Thursday, brokers said.
Bogota's IBB index dropped 0.31 percent to 1,066.72 amid a 4.2 billion peso volume while Medellin's IBOMED general price index ended 0.15 percent down at 16,541.51 amid a 5.3 billion peso trade.
"There were a lot of stocks on offer today as investors tried to get a bit of liquidity before Easter week," one Bogota trader said.
Brewing giant Bavaria fell 1.3 percent to 6,810 in Bogota and 1.01 percent to 6,830 in Medellin.
